scope: Benchmark-kernel-only exact ARM64 NEON transpose and sqrt specialization; no production frame or cross-engine claim
quality: All4workloads at1003rows/12steps: baseline,tuned,SIMD fullbit state equal, serial+14workers. Every1m timed before/after W1/W3 output hash agrees. No approximations or expression reassociation.
method: 16fresh sequential processes, two reversed engine/case rounds,1mrows, W1warm120/W3warm3000 then300samples. nice10, sampledresources/power stable. One caller in addition to14workers forparallel; serial has no rowtasks.
review: Independent source review: no must-fix in bit permutation, full4-float bounds/alignment, NEON cfg, actual IEEEsqrt or unchanged fallback. BenchClippy-Dwarnings andfmt pass.
limits: This fixture optimization is not yet used in production engine math.
Only Mac AArch64 tested. Other architectures retain original math.
Two process samples per case; descriptive results, not confidence intervals.
